kind_of_thing.quote: A tram, also known as a tramcar, streetcar or trolley is a form of urban rail transit in which vehicles, whether individual railcars or multiple-unit trains, run on tramway tracks laid on or parallel to public streets, or operate in segregated right-of-ways.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: A tram (tramcar, streetcar or trolley) is a passenger vehicle that is like a light train.
